about: Which Odoo Community modules FeteLABS ships. fetelabs/prune.py reads this file. Every l10n_* module not listed under localisations is removed, every module under remove is removed, and anything that depends on a removed module goes with it. Generic apps (accounting, sales, point of sale, events, inventory, website, HR and the rest) stay because they work anywhere.

localisations.l10n_do: Dominican Republic: chart of accounts, ITBIS taxes, NCF fiscal documents
localisations.l10n_us: Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands (US jurisdictions)
localisations.l10n_us_account: Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands: US chart and check printing
localisations.l10n_fr: Guadeloupe, Martinique, St. Barth and French St. Martin (base for the French overseas modules)
localisations.l10n_fr_account: French chart and taxes; required by Guadeloupe and Martinique
localisations.l10n_fr_facturx_chorus_pro: French public-sector e-invoicing, which applies in the overseas departments
localisations.l10n_fr_pdp: The French e-invoicing reform (from September 2026) covers businesses in Guadeloupe and Martinique
localisations.l10n_fr_pdp_pos: The French e-invoicing reform at the point of sale
localisations.l10n_fr_pos_cert: French certified-till rules for point of sale (applies in the overseas departments)
localisations.l10n_fr_hr_holidays: French leave rules for the French islands
localisations.l10n_fr_hr_work_entry_holidays: French leave rules for the French islands
localisations.l10n_nl: Bonaire, Saba and St. Eustatius (the Caribbean Netherlands are part of the Netherlands)
localisations.l10n_account_withholding_tax: Generic withholding tax, used by several island tax systems
localisations.l10n_account_withholding_tax_pos: Generic withholding tax at the point of sale

no_localisation: Every other island (Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Aruba, the Bahamas, Barbados, Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Curaçao, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, Jamaica, Montserrat, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Lucia, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Sint Maarten, Trinidad and Tobago, the Turks and Caicos) has no Odoo localisation. They use the generic chart of accounts with their own VAT or sales tax set up as taxes.

remove.payment_aps: Amazon Payment Services: Middle East only
remove.payment_mercado_pago: Mercado Pago: South America and Mexico only
remove.payment_nuvei: Nuvei (Odoo integration): Latin American and Canadian currencies only
remove.payment_paymob: Paymob: Egypt and the Gulf only
remove.payment_payu: PayU: India and Central Europe only
remove.pos_mercado_pago: Mercado Pago terminals: South America and Mexico
remove.delivery_mondialrelay: Mondial Relay pickup points: mainland France and Benelux
remove.website_sale_mondialrelay: Mondial Relay pickup points on the shop: mainland France and Benelux
remove.transifex: Links to Odoo's own translation project; not a FeteLABS feature

kept_integrations_note: Payment providers kept: Adyen, Authorize.net (Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands), Mollie (euro islands), PayPal, Stripe, wire transfer and cash. Check that a provider takes merchants on a given island before offering it there.
